services.name: Christmas Cruise
services.desc: A 2-hour Sunset & Fireworks Cruise. There is nothing like seeing fireworks from the water, the reflections & sound are amazing. Cruising on Lake Dora and Lake Beauclair, this tour will travel the shoreline as we look out for birds of prey and waterfowl, before enjoying the sunset over the lake. As dusk falls, the spectacular Independence Day Fireworks will commence. On July 3rd, fireworks are by the City of Mount Dora, on July 4th, they are by the City of Tavares. Don't forget to bring a drink if you want to. If we do not have people reserved, we do not send a Captain to the boat! Call daily between 9 am and 5

blurb: Guests join pontoon boat tours on Lake Dora and the Harris Chain of Lakes, including the famous Dora Canal. Tours are narrated by certified captains and crew who share stories and local knowledge about the area's history, flora, and fauna. Common wildlife sightings include bald eagles, herons, anhingas, turtles, and alligators.
